lede: The biggest thing on the board this week is the Ouray joint session Monday where county commissioners and city council will hear public comment on a proposed intergovernmental agreement to hand all of Ouray's law enforcement over to the Sheriff's Office starting January 1 — a structural change that doesn't happen quietly. Closer to home, Telluride Town Council meets Tuesday with a public hearing on a development vesting extension and a work session on automated license plate reader cameras, while San Miguel County's BOCC and Planning Commission both take up affordable housing policy in separate sessions Wednesday and Thursday.
